shorterRoute: The native orbit-potential theorem already handles arbitrary additive coefficients; no new finite-permutation or cohomological foundation is needed. Its scalar Shapiro cocycle matches the native coinduced coordinates. Original subgroup coefficient triviality, signed translation classification and native H1 pullback then prove the exact original parabolic comparison and counit stability.
assumptionsToDischarge: Construct local coinduced coboundaries from literal vanishing on stabilizer powers, using existing orbit potentials.
Transport to the original coefficient action with native subgroup triviality.
Prove every required conjugate power remains parabolic from literal squared trace four.
Prove native Shapiro sends the original subgroup parabolic classes to coinduced parabolic classes.
Identify the actual Gamma1 constant-H1 comparison on cocycles and derive parabolic preservation of the original transfer.
remaining: Parabolic stability is proved; it does not show that every reduced integral parabolic class has a parabolic preimage. That surjectivity, exceptional-prime removal, two-dimensional characteristic-zero realization, original all-weight association, automorphy and higher continuation remain required.
